⚠ You are billed for what it already delivered; the server re-prices the rest once the workflow settles. What the ledger ends up doing is decided server-side — this CLI cannot see your Buzz ledger — `civitai buzz` reports a balance, not a history, so settle it against your Buzz transaction history (/user/transactions). Check what it produced before stopping with `civitai workflows get 01JABCXYZ`.
